forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {世話|せわ}していませんでした

definitions.explanation: Taking care of someone or something; helping someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm taking care of the children.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{世話|せわ}→お世話：02506_osewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Taking care of a dog is hard work.

notes:
⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧ covers both practical caregiving (looking after children, pets) and the broader sense of helping or assisting someone. It is used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{世話|せわ}する

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take care of, to look after
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}になる→お世話になる：25410_osewaninaru⟧: to receive someone's help/care
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}→お世話：02506_osewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧: Thank you for your help (set phrase for parting)
- ⟦{世話|せわ}→世話：02088_sewa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to fuss over, to meddle
- {世話|せわ}⟦{焼|や}き→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: busybody, meddler

USAGE:
The polite prefix お is almost always added in social contexts: ⟦お{世話|せわ}になっております→お世話になっております：23569_osewaninatteorimasu⟧ is a standard business greeting meaning "Thank you for your continued support."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to take care of (emphasizes effort/burden)
- ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧: nursing care (specifically for elderly or disabled)
- ⟦{看病|かんびょう}→看病：16956_kanbyou⟧: caring for a sick person
